notes.text: Section 951, acts July 17, 1916, ch. 245, title I, § 28, 39 Stat. 381; Ex. Ord. No. 6084, Mar. 27, 1933; Aug. 19, 1937, ch. 704, § 20, 50 Stat. 710, provided for appointment of farm credit examiners.
